name: navbar-centered-logo
title: Centered logo navbar
description: A navbar with the mark on the true middle, links on the left and actions on the right, folding into a menu button on a phone.
docs: The props match Navbar (brand, items, actions, currentHref, linkAs, sticky), so one can replace the other: items are links, or groups that open as panels in the shared navigation menu. The three zones are one grid, so the brand stays on the true middle. The links only sit beside it where they fit: a side of the bar has room for about three short links at 768px, five at 1024px and six at 1280px, and no more than that at any width. The bar folds them into the sheet below the width that suits their number (md up to three links, lg for four, xl beyond that, so keep the list to six); pass foldBelow (md, lg or xl) to choose it yourself, for a wide mark or long labels. The current page gets aria-current and a thin underline that grows from the centre on hover and focus. Where the links fold they move into a sheet opened from the menu button on the left (menuLabel names it), and below md the actions fold into one icon button on the right that opens them in a popover; actionsLabel names the button and the popover, and actionsIcon changes its icon. Pass linkAs={Link} for your router's links.
